## FOUNDATIONAL ARCHITECTURE — READ THIS FIRST

This spec implements the **Citizen-Centric Directory System** defined in:
`docs/canonical/CITIZEN_CENTRIC_DIRECTORY_SYSTEM_FOUNDATION_2026-07-27.md`
(SHA: a9fcb9ba31215abaa71da1e40dc7c9fa0dd0f108)

**The governing principle:** Strict separation of two pillars:

**PILLAR 1 — SYSTEM PILLARS (WHERE and WHAT GOVERNS THEM)**
The external environment — jurisdiction, government, laws, services.
Seven universal categories: Governance, Economy, Security, Infrastructure, Wellbeing, Education, Community.
Jurisdictional waterfall: Federal → State → County → Municipal → District/Precinct.

**PILLAR 2 — CITIZEN AFFINITIES (WHO THEY ARE)**
The internal person — identity, beliefs, lifestyle, vocation, family, causes.
Twelve affinity dimensions mapping to BGOP's 38-category donor taxonomy.

**The donor group is the INTERSECTION of these two pillars — never a pre-mixed category.**

Never mix System Pillars with Citizen Affinities in the same hierarchy node.
Wrong: County → Recreation → Fox Hunting (mixes geography with lifestyle)
Right: System Pillar: Wilkes County → Community + Affinity: Lifestyle → Fox Hunting → Intersection: "Fox Hunters in Wilkes County"
